title: 分源部署（控制台与 API 不同源）时，#37225 改过的 7 处请求仍不带令牌（接 #37225）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S4 of the seat's L2 on PR #37489 (#37225), record 7187820695; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37225. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: a console deployed with the API on another origin (split origin), under a bearer-only session · evidence: L2 record 7187820695; os-dev report 7187574466.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：宿主的认证 fetch 只给同源请求加令牌。控制台和 API 分在不同源部署时，#37225 改过的 7 处请求会不带令牌发出。
- 谁受益：分源部署的租户。
- 不做会怎样：分源部署下这些功能仍按匿名处理。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- The host `createAuthenticatedFetch` is built with `sameOriginOnly`, so when the configured server URL (or `VITE_AI_BASE_URL`) is on another origin, the 7 calls #37225 converted go out without the bearer.
- Decide how a split-origin deployment names its trusted API origin (an allow-list from config), and attach the bearer for it.

## Acceptance

- Under a split-origin config with a bearer-only session, the 7 calls carry the bearer to the configured API origin and never to any other origin; pins for both.

Blocked-by: #37225
